title: Figure 2: GMR resistance vs magnetic field and spin-dependent electron scattering model
description: Composite figure captioned 'Figure 2. (a) Resistance of a magnetic multilayer R versus magnetic field. (b) Origin of GMR in terms of spin-dependent electron scattering... (c) The equivalent resistance circuits corresponding to the three magnetic configurations shown in (b).' Panel (a) is a peaked R curve labeled R_AF, R_F and B_s versus 'Magnetic Field'; (b) shows electron paths through layers F1 and F2; (c) shows resistor networks with R and r.
